nina (secops): Action required: we're enforcing stricter service-account RBAC for all inference namespaces. Goal: remove any direct cluster-admin bindings and stop automatic token automounts for runtime SAs. This reduces blast radius for Dedicated and Private customers. Please read and follow the audit steps below.

ben (eng-sre): Why now? Did we see a misuse or is this part of hardening roadmap?

nina (secops): It's proactive hardening after a recent public CVE chain that increases impact when workloads use broad SA privileges. No known exploit in our infra, but we want to reduce risk surface now.

raj (eng-platform): TL;DR rollout plan: 1) Run the rbac-audit script in infra/tools to get a report per cluster; 2) Teams have 5 days to remediate findings marked `critical` (cluster-admin or wildcard verbs on core resources); 3) After 5 days, platform will automatically remove cluster-admin RoleBindings on service accounts labeled `inference.*` and set `automountServiceAccountToken: false` where safe; 4) Exceptions must be filed.

mia (product-security): Quick notes for Private deployments: we'll provide the same tooling and a migration guide. Private customers can opt to run it themselves or ask Redwood infra to run under an NDA-assisted service (ETA 3 business days).

nina (secops): How to audit (run as cluster-admin or via infra runbook):

```
# clone repo and run audit
git clone https://git.internal/redwood/infra.git
cd infra/tools/rbac-audit
# generates csv/json report per-namespace
./rbac-audit --clusters $(cat ../clusters.txt) --filter "namespace:inference*" --output /tmp/rbac-report

# quick check for cluster-admin bindings
kubectl get clusterrolebinding -o json | jq '.items[] | select(.subjects[]?.kind=="ServiceAccount") | {name: .metadata.name, subjects: .subjects}'
```

ben (eng-sre): For owners that still need broad privileges (legacy ops), use the recommended least-privilege roles in infra/roles/inference-roles.yaml and open a ticket with `rbac-exception: <team>` in #eng-security. Exceptions are timeboxed 14 days and require Service Owner + Security sign-off.

raj (eng-platform): Migration helpers: repo contains a kustomize patch that flips `automountServiceAccountToken: false` and a reconciliation controller that will warn first for 48h, then apply the change. Controller PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/777. We'll run a canary in non-prod tomorrow.

nina (secops): Dashboard & alerts: rbsa-bot will create a Console tile with `rbac.audit.findings` and we will alert on new `cluster-admin` findings. ETA 8 hours.

rbac-bot: [scan] completed cluster-canary-us-east: 4 findings -> 2 low (unused verbs), 1 medium (wildcard on configmaps), 1 critical (sa: inference-runner -> cluster-admin via legacy-binding).

mia (product-security): Owners: please prioritize removing cluster-admin first. If your workload truly needs broad privileges for a short migration window, request an exception. We'll partner to create scoped role templates to replace cluster-admin usage.

ben (eng-sre): Operational note: when automount is disabled, some apps that expect tokens in /var/run/secrets may fail; use the provided init sidecar to inject a temporary token for bootstrap if needed. See infra/tools/rbac-audit/README.md for the sidecar snippet.

nina (secops): Enforcement timeline summary: 5 days to remediate critical findings; automatic remediation begins after deadline for unattended bindings in inference namespaces. Private customers have 10 days to schedule. Non-compliance will result in temporary throttling of the workload to reduce exposure, and platform will notify the owning team.

raj (eng-platform): If you see CI failures after the canary, ping me and we'll allow a 48h grace window in test clusters by flipping `rbac.grace=true` in test cluster config.

nina (secops): Thanks all. Action items for individual teams: 1) Run rbac-audit and attach report to your ticket; 2) Remove cluster-admin bindings or map to scoped inference roles; 3) Test apps with automount disabled. Questions or exceptions: mention @nina or @ben. :lock_with_ink_pen:
